responsibility: This header declares the pointer_equiv_analyzer, a dominator-walk helper for tracking edge-sensitive pointer SSA equivalences. It exposes the enter/leave/visit_stmt/get_equiv interface used by range and folding code to discover invariant pointees or replacement pointer values in the current context, along with the predicate that filters supported pointer SSA expressions.
same_name_distinction: Declares the pointer_equiv_analyzer interface and the supported_pointer_equiv_p helper, while the companion .cc file provides the scoped equivalence-stack machinery and the actual discovery/query logic.
